_comment: HAND-CURATED (vfw.json lineage) — the homepage FEATURED EVENTS slider. One entry per shoutout; the FIRST entry leads (items show in this order). match = a case-insensitive fragment of the live event's title; date = the event's day (YYYY-MM-DD, ET); blurb (optional, short — shown after an em dash); from (optional, YYYY-MM-DD — first day the shoutout shows; default 14 days before). The shoutout ends when the event ends. Several live rows matching → the shortest title wins. No matching live row → nothing shows (never fabricated). The build validates this file: a bad comma fails the build. everyone (optional, true) = skip the viewer’s SOURCE gate for this item so it reaches Marauders and Locals alike (audience gate still applies).

items.blurb: Free family evening · Fri, Dec 4 at 5:30 PM
